Shanice: Yes, we are. Do you want me to fix some of your sexbot’s parts?
You: Maybe later. I wanted to ask if you learned something new about these organizations we talked about some time ago.
Shanice: Oh, you mean these organizations that want to kidnap and take apart your bot and kill you?
You: W-what?! Kill me?! 
Shanice: That was a joke, stop panicking. Geez!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Actually, they would want to cover their tracks so killing all the witnesses is a probable course of action. 
Shanice: Good job Priestcan. If Anon pisses his pants, you will be the one who cleans up. Just saying.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m just being honest. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: And please Anon, do not piss yourself. It would be a bother and a sin. 
You: You two aren’t very good at calming people down…
Shanice: Don’t worry! You should be fine. At least for now.
